lenses.name: Commuting out
lenses.description: Share of employed residents whose workplace is outside their commune of residence. Arrondissements are recombined into Paris, Lyon and Marseille; small census flows are magnitudes.

lenses.name: Workplace-job balance
lenses.description: Jobs located in the area divided by employed residents living there. Above 1 means a net workplace inflow; below 1 means residents commute out. This is a ratio, not a count of jobs.

lenses.name: Local employment capture
lenses.description: Share of workplace jobs held by people who also live in the same area. Low values indicate strong inbound commuting or large employment centres.
